data: Which color line has the steepest increase in values?

The question asks which color line has the steepest increase in values. From the analysis of the key visual elements, the orange line represents the "Retriever recall at N," and it shows a steeper increase compared to the other lines. The blue line represents "Ranker recall at N," and the gray line represents "Top-N exact match." Both these lines show a relatively gradual increase. The yellow line represents "Ranker recall at N (strict)," and it also shows a gradual increase but not as steep as the orange line. Therefore, the orange line has the steepest increase in values.
